verdict.rationale: The SoS's own filing page (FileDoc.do) lists the founder's core transactions as filing entry points: forming LLCs, profit, nonprofit and public benefit corporations, cooperatives and partnerships, registering foreign entities (with a filing tutorial), reserving names and registering trademarks. The business portal adds periodic report filing and trade name renewal, so the core formation and filing transaction is served online. Missing for 10: explicit first-party wording that a filing is submitted and paid entirely online (fees and payment flow are unevidenced), and any hands-on or independent confirmation of a completed online filing.
